title: Return policy
body: Most items can be returned within the return window shown on the product page (7, 30, 60 or 90 days depending on the product). Items marked 'No return policy' – such as groceries, opened cosmetics and fragrances – cannot be returned unless they arrive damaged. Start a return from My Orders > Return item. Products must be unused and in original packaging with tags attached.

title: When will I get my refund?
body: Once the returned item passes quality check at our warehouse, refunds are issued within 2 business days. UPI and wallet refunds arrive instantly, card refunds take 5-7 business days, and Cash on Delivery orders are refunded to your ShopSphere wallet or bank account of your choice.

title: Exchanging for a different size or colour
body: Clothing, shoes and watches can be exchanged for a different size or colour within the return window at no extra cost. Choose 'Exchange' instead of 'Return' in My Orders. If the new size is out of stock we automatically convert the request into a refund.

title: My item arrived damaged or defective
body: Report damaged, defective or wrong items within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the product and packaging. We send a free replacement or a full refund, including for items that are otherwise non-returnable, and arrange free pickup.

title: Delivery times and shipping charges
body: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days in metro cities and 5-8 days elsewhere. Shipping is free on orders above $50; below that a flat $4.99 fee applies. Delivery estimates for each product are shown on the product page, for example 'Ships in 1-2 business days' or 'Ships overnight'.

title: Express and same-day delivery
body: Express delivery (next day) is available for $9.99 in Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai and Pune for orders placed before 2 PM. Same-day delivery is available on selected electronics and groceries in Mumbai and Bengaluru.

title: Do you ship internationally?
body: We currently ship to India, UAE, Singapore and the UK. International orders take 7-14 business days and customs duties are paid by the recipient. Vehicles, motorcycles and groceries cannot be shipped internationally.

title: How do I track my order?
body: Go to My Orders and click 'Track'. You also receive SMS and WhatsApp updates at every stage: packed, shipped, out for delivery and delivered. If tracking hasn't updated for 72 hours, contact support and we will escalate with the courier.

title: Cancelling an order
body: Orders can be cancelled free of charge until they are shipped. After shipping, refuse the delivery or raise a return once it arrives. Pre-orders and made-to-order furniture can be cancelled within 24 hours of purchase.

title: Payment methods we accept
body: We accept UPI, all major credit and debit cards, net banking, ShopSphere wallet and gift cards. Payments are processed through PCI-DSS compliant gateways and we never store your full card number.

title: Is Cash on Delivery available?
body: Cash on Delivery is available for orders up to $500 at most pin codes. COD is not available for vehicles, motorcycles, luxury watches above $1,000 or international orders.

title: No-cost EMI and instalments
body: No-cost EMI for 3, 6 or 9 months is available on orders above $150 with major bank credit cards. Laptops, smartphones, tablets and furniture also support 12-month EMI. Choose EMI at checkout to see the plans available for your card.

title: Warranty claims
body: Warranty periods are listed on each product page (for example '1 year warranty' or 'Lifetime warranty'). To claim, open My Orders > Warranty claim and upload the invoice and a short description of the issue. Electronics are repaired or replaced by authorised service centres, typically within 7-10 days.

title: Extended warranty and device protection
body: ShopSphere Care adds up to 2 extra years of warranty plus accidental and liquid damage cover for smartphones, laptops, tablets and watches. It can be bought at checkout or within 30 days of delivery.

title: Price drop and price match
body: If the price of an item drops within 7 days of your purchase, we credit the difference to your ShopSphere wallet automatically. We do not match prices from other retailers. Coupons cannot be combined with each other but do stack with product discounts.

title: Gift cards and gift wrapping
body: Digital gift cards from $10 to $500 are delivered by email and valid for 12 months. Gift wrapping with a personal message is available for $2.99 per item, and prices are hidden on the invoice for gift orders.

title: ShopSphere Plus membership
body: ShopSphere Plus costs $29 per year and includes free express delivery, early access to sales and 2% cashback as reward points on every order. Points can be redeemed at checkout, 100 points equal $1.

title: Contact customer support
body: Chat with us 24x7 in the app, email help@shopsphere.example, or call our toll-free number between 8 AM and 10 PM IST. Support is available in English, Hindi, Marathi, Tamil and Telugu.

title: Grocery freshness guarantee
body: Fresh produce, meat and dairy are delivered with at least 70% of their shelf life remaining. If anything is not fresh, report it within 24 hours for an instant refund – no return needed.

title: Buying vehicles and motorcycles
body: Vehicles and motorcycles are delivered through partner dealerships who handle registration, insurance and number plates. You can book a test ride online for free. A booking amount of 10% is collected online and the balance is paid at the dealership.
